summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtin helper, not committed. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `from enum import Enum` and the str-valued EndpointResolverBuiltins enum with eleven members, each commented with meaning and type. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint; made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept endpoint_config=None (treated as no variant tags); added ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults, which composes the bridge's FIPS and DualStack lookups and the existing S3 and STS predicates. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added the EPRBuiltins-style enum import and class TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with one test per behavioral criterion. Choices: the absent SDK endpoint is returned as None so all eleven keys are present; the bridge's private lookups were used since no public ones exist; FIPS and DualStack use `or False`; the default client config is None. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py passes (58 tests), and the related test_regions and test_client suites pass. The full unit suite has 11 failures, and the same failures occur on the unmodified tree (9 in test_awsrequest.py, 2 test_internal_component in the session tests), so they predate this change. One pre-existing line over 79 columns remains in args.py (line 315), which is untouched. black and isort were not run.
